title: Warehouse stock-count web app v28→v40: design system v2 (Maison), multi-search, highlight, shelf groups, scan mode, award-site motion, measured gate
request: نفذ المقترح واستخدم قدرات التنين الاسود في تطوير الخطوط والموشن جرافك وايقونات الموقع وغيرها
agent: Claude (claude.ai cloud session; repo not attached, repo scripts not executed: permission classifier refused external code)
tools: WebSearch/WebFetch research + 3 research subagents (2 completed, 1 rate-limited)

params.motion: hover 140ms std, press 80/140ms, modal 300ms expo-out, list stagger 50ms (KOSIF product-ui playbook)
params.icons: 24-grid, 1.7 stroke, round joins; self-drawing check; scan icon

inputs.name: SMACC stock report (2,533 items) embedded as base-data JSON in the page
user Excel of brand/model/group per item (ref-data)
carparts247 / oemwolf cross-reference JSON built earlier (xref, sup)
kosif-tool playbooks/product-ui.md and playbooks/arabic-typography.md (read from a shallow clone)

steps.what: research: 3 parallel subagents (award sites, SaaS dashboards, luxury + Arabic/RTL) with WebSearch/WebFetch; two reports delivered (~100 sources/products)
steps.manual: creative-sites agent stopped on a 5-hour usage limit

steps.what: design system v2 stylesheet (v2.css) replacing four stacked theme layers; markup restructure (ring dashboard, toolbar, sticky column heads)

search-term highlighting with Arabic/digit normalisation (patch25); keyboard help, location colours, top progress hairline, favicon, print CSS (patch26); shelf group headers, blind count, export scope chooser, status icons (patch27); icon grammar, kinetic title, scan mode, motion tokens (patch28)
steps.command: bash build.sh   # chains patch3..patch28 over the base page

steps.what: regression: 6 headless screenshots (3 themes x desktop/phone), multi-search + marks, highlight, groups, scan mode, export chooser
steps.command: node t24.js; node t19b.js; node t28.js; node t31.js; node t33.js; node t32.js

steps.what: measured gate: 21 fg/bg pairs x 3 themes contrast (alpha-composited), basic a11y audit, RTL physical-property scan
publish artifact versions 28..39 to the same URL
steps.manual: published in-session as requested by the user

steps.what: v40: award-site research (23 sites probed live by a subagent) applied: easing set with ease-in exits, two-tone focus ring, KPI radial glow, mobile tab-strip edge fade, spring linear() toggle, 180ms view transition on status swap; plus clear-all-filters chip, 1-5 tab keys (off in scan mode), toast pause on hover
steps.command: bash build.sh && node t24.js && node t36.js && node t33.js && node gate.js

measured.rtl_physical_leaks_in_css: 8 (all deliberate: centred toast/pill, tab indicator, hairlines)

reproduce.how: Start from the base page (out/v4.html) with the data JSON blocks, run build.sh which applies patch3..patch28 in order and writes out/index.html; run the Playwright scripts for screenshots and the gate; publish index.html to the artifact URL with capabilities db+user(profile)+downloads+assets. The patch scripts and v2.css live in the session container, not in this repository; add them under projects/warehouse-count/ to make this record replayable.
prerequisites: Google Fonts reachable (Amiri, Noto Kufi Arabic, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, IBM Plex Mono)

evidence: gate.txt (contrast table), screenshots d1-d4/m1-m2/k3/g2 in the session
lessons: A <button> nested inside the row's <button class=r-main> was silently splitting the row DOM; use <span role=button>.
background-clip:text on a parent with animated inline-block children hides the text; clip on the children.
Line-clamp/ellipsis on mixed RTL/LTR lines mis-cuts; clip by max-height instead.
The repo's scripts cannot run from a cloud chat without attaching the repo; the classifier refuses external code.
notes: Research reports used: Stripe/Linear/Apple HIG/Material/Polaris/Square/Odoo (dashboard patterns); Rolex/Cartier/Hermes/Dior/AP + NEOM/Aramco/Al Rajhi + W3C alreq (luxury and Arabic/RTL rules). v40 adds the creative-sites report (Lusion, Locomotive, Immersive Garden, Obys, Exo Ape, Resn, Active Theory, Studio Freight, Basement, Hello Monday, Unseen, Dogstudio, By-Kin, Iventions, Mat Voyce, aengel, Long Hoang, Linear, Vercel, Stripe, Apple, Lando Norris, Igloo).
